text:
rachel: Heads-up: tomorrow we flip the new price sheet for cohort B. Two quick asks: (1) confirm grandfathering rule, (2) decide how credits show up in portal for partner-billed customers.

noah: Proposal: grandfather any subscription created before T0 and active at T0. Exclude trials and upgrades that started during experiment. Tag as `grandfather=true`.

sima: From ops: credit memos on next invoice for platform-billed accounts. For partner-billed, we can't touch partner invoices  recommend platform promo (non-ledger) up to $40 while partner processes refund.

rachel: Agreed. Let's auto-apply promo for partner rows and include `partner_passthrough=true` so partner-ops gets a handoff CSV.

noah: SQL I'll run:```sql
select customer_id from subscriptions where created_at < '2026-05-01' and status='active';
```

sima: Add columns: estimated_credit_usd, tax_country, partner_passthrough, promo_issued. Finance needs exposure total. Small credits < $100 auto-apply; >$100 route to review.

partner-ops: We'll accept handoff CSV and contact partners. Suggested wording: "Please issue refund or confirm partner promo within 5 business days."

billing-bot: Tagging job queued 00:30 UTC. Export target: https://internal.redwood/exports/2034567890-cohortB-export.csv

rachel: Action items: Noah run tag/export (EOD). Sima include exposure and tax columns. Partner-ops prepare handoff. Locking plan at 15:30 PT if no objections.

noah: Running now.

billing-bot: Job started 00:32 UTC  642 accounts tagged with `grandfather=true`. Export uploaded.
